en.titre:
10/10 cozy hobbies that actually
work if you have adhd

colonne: measuring and mixing keep your hands busy, and in 12 minutes you have something to _show for it_
en.chute: one easy recipe, saved on paper

colonne: a cozy spot with nothing else to do helps a scattered brain stay on the same page for _longer_
en.chute: start with 10 pages, not a whole chapter

colonne: late openings are calm, and standing in front of one piece slows a busy mind right down
_pro tip_: artura gives me one painting a day and the story behind it, in a few minutes
en.chute: check which museum opens late this week

en.accroche: you pick them today and _open the book_ next _week_
colonne: it's slow, gentle and hands-on, and the wait makes the result feel like a small _surprise_
en.chute: one heavy book and flowers from a walk

colonne: an easy run gives a restless body somewhere to go, and a weekly plan keeps it _gentle_
_pro tip_: atala builds my runs around my goal and adjusts them every week
